title: Which Countries Survive? 🌍 Marble Elimination · Round 1 Heat 6/7
description:
Flagball Arena · Season 1, Round 1 · Heat 6/7: 27 countries race through 3 stages — only 13 survive and go to Round 2.

Countries in this heat: Angola, Bangladesh, Bhutan, Cuba, Japan, Liberia, Liechtenstein, Mali, Malta, Namibia, Netherlands, New Zealand, North Macedonia, Norway, Palau, Panama, Russia, Sao Tome and Principe, Sierra Leone, Slovakia, Sudan, Trinidad and Tobago, Tunisia, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Vanuatu, Yemen.

Countries still in the game before this race: 123 of 193.
Next race: Round 1 · Heat 7/7. Grand Final: Nov 9.

How it works: all 193 countries race in heats → Round 2 → Semi-finals → Grand Final, then a new season starts. 3 new races every day.

Like 👍 if your country survived and write in the comments who you're cheering for!
